name: Spanish Gangster Disciples
description: The Spanish Gangster Disciples (SGD) are a predominantly Latino Folk Nation street gang founded in the early 1980s by Rudy Rios — a former Latin Scorpions/MLD member — in South Chicago at 88th & Houston, as an offshoot of the Gangster Disciples operating under the 'Spanish Growth and Development' concept with BGD hierarchy backing. A separate Northside chapter formed in 1983 near Clark & Olive. Founder Rudy Rios was assassinated in 1995, triggering leadership losses and territorial decline on the South Side, with Ambrose absorbing most of their South Chicago turf by 1997. Active sets remain in Albany Park and northern suburbs including Elgin, Wheeling, Palatine, and Waukegan.
